verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page directly claims employees can be reimbursed in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, paid in their local currency within two days. That is native in-product support, so no separate international payments process is needed. The evidence is a single marketing claim with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on FX handling, payout rails and setup for international reimbursements; explicit confirmation that these run in the same reimbursement workflow as domestic ones; independent or hands-on corroboration.
